# qrcode-generator 2.0.4

Vendored ESM distribution for client-side QR generation. Loaded lazily when opening a game's QR dialog; no external QR service or CDN is used at runtime.

Source package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator/v/2.0.4

Downloaded source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/qrcode-generator@2.0.4/dist/qrcode.mjs

Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

License: MIT; copyright Kazuhiko Arase. See qrcode-LICENSE.txt and the source header. Upstream implementation is retained without modification.
